content: sass-embedded 1.77.0 works on arm64 macOS but GitHub Actions has had limited support for compiling Sass for M1 Macs. Performance differs on arm64 vs x64 macOS - x64 is self-contained executable while arm64 uses runtime+snapshot combo with higher startup overhead. Bootstrap SCSS deprecation issues with older sass-embedded versions may still be relevant, so the ~> 1.77.0 pin should be maintained until confirmed resolved.
